sections.benefits.label: Benefits text
sections.benefits.llm_value: The rate of scholarship is Rs.12,000/- per annum at Graduation level for first three years of College and University courses and Rs.20,000/- per annum at Post-Graduation level.
sections.benefits.value: Rs 12,000 per year at graduation level for the first three years of college and university courses, and Rs 20,000 per year at post-graduation level. Students in professional courses lasting five years, or integrated courses, get Rs 20,000 per year in the 4th and 5th years. Students in technical courses such as B.Tech or B.Engg get the scholarship up to graduation level only: Rs 12,000 per year for the 1st, 2nd and 3rd years and Rs 20,000 in the 4th year. The money is paid directly into the student's own savings bank account by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

sections.documents.label: Documents text
sections.documents.llm_value: Income certificate will be required only for the fresh applicants.
sections.documents.value: Income certificate (needed only for fresh applicants, not for renewal). Caste and educational qualification details are verified online through DigiLocker. The student must have a savings bank account in their own name, because the scholarship is paid by Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The guidelines do not give a full checklist; see the National Scholarships Portal (NSP) for the complete document list.

review.note: combined from 4(v) p2, 6(i) and 8 p3; PDF has no full checklist

sections.process.label: Process text
sections.process.llm_value: Beneficiaries/ Applicants under the scheme must apply online in the National Scholarships Portal (www.scholarships.gov.in) for the fresh/ renewal scholarships.
sections.process.value: Apply online on the National Scholarships Portal (www.scholarships.gov.in) for both fresh and renewal scholarships; applications sent directly to the Ministry of Education are not accepted. Caste and educational qualifications are verified through DigiLocker. Applications are verified at two levels: first by the student's institute, then by the State Higher Education Department or State Nodal Agency. NSP announces the opening and closing dates and publishes the selection list. To renew each year, the student needs at least 50% marks in the annual examination and at least 75% attendance; complaints of indiscipline or ragging lead to loss of the scholarship. Renewal applications must be submitted by the cut-off date, or renewal for that year is not allowed. A student who missed renewal can apply for renewal in a later year if they meet the renewal conditions.
